note: ONE source of truth for BookPro14,1 power and fan targets. The root applier (scripts/mbp14_power_apply.py) and the stability checker (scripts/power_stability.py) both read this file, so they can never disagree. Edit values here, then re-run scripts/install_power_root_unit.sh, which copies it to /etc/mbp14/power-policy.json. The values are the original owner's choices, not upstream defaults: battery = a 10-hour design (turbo off, capped frequency, low power limits) while the fan may still run; plugged in = performance with active cooling. Change them to suit yourself: see docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

epp.why: Energy-saving CPU hint; {{OWNER}} chose the 10-hour design (2026-11-19).

no_turbo.why: Turbo is the biggest battery drain; off on battery.

max_freq_khz.why: 2.3 GHz cap keeps the CPU efficient on battery.

pl1_uw.why: 9 W sustained package limit for the 10-hour target.

pl2_uw.why: 13 W short burst limit so the laptop still feels responsive.

fan_min_rpm.why: Firmware minimum (1200). The fan is NOT forbidden on battery: thermald and the firmware may spin it up as needed; the policy simply does not force a higher floor, which saves power.

fan_policy.why: Let thermald and firmware pick the speed above the floor.

ac.label: Plugged in: performance with active cooling

epp.why: Fast but still efficient while on mains.

pl1_uw.why: 15 W sustained: the chip's rated TDP (Intel ARK).

pl2_uw.why: 25 W burst: the chip's rated maximum short-term power.

fan_min_rpm.why: A raised floor (firmware minimum is 1200) so the fan is already moving before heat builds: intended to give sustained performance with less throttling (we measured 91 to 100 C package temperature under heavy load: see docs/CAVEATS.md). {{OWNER}}: plugged in, it needs to use its fan.

fan_policy.why: Above the floor, thermald and firmware may raise the speed further.

limits.note: The root applier clamps every value to these ranges, so a tampered policy file cannot push the hardware outside these guard rails (they are guard rails, not a safety guarantee).
